legend.roles: personal = the login's own member role (no body_cid); club = a club role addressed with body_cid; public = no login (rankings public key)
legend.mode: read = runnable through scripts/sport80 js; guided = the agent walks the owner through the portal's own form and follows confirm; owner-only = the agent never drives it
legend.verified: live = descriptor or page and rows exercised; descriptor = descriptor or page loaded, rows not read; page = page shape only; none = seen in a menu or the bundle, never exercised; denied = the role gets 401 or 403
legend.seen: menu = in a role menu; props = in shared page props; page = linked from a page; bundle = referenced in the front-end code; tab = a profile tab
